title: Tidy the feed helpers and the sync module
description: Housekeeping ahead of the per-depot work. The cell helpers move out of `parse.ts` into `cells.ts`, so the depot parser can share them without importing the whole parser; `key()` moves to the top of reconcile beside the types it keys; main starts the status server beside the state it serves instead of after the sync closure; and a couple of function bodies are reordered so their declarations sit together. Two helpers get names of their own: `largestAdjustment` out of `summarise`, which the alerts will want, and the feed client's status check. The reconcile tests are grouped by whether the warehouse knows the SKU, and apply's transaction loop is tidied. Should be behaviour-neutral.

commit.subject: Tidy the feed helpers and the sync module
commit.body:
cells.ts takes lines, normaliseSku and quantityOf; key() to the top of
reconcile; the status server beside its state in main; largestAdjustment
and checkStatus extracted; reconcile tests grouped.
